mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% in a month, the S&P 500 forward 20-day return turns negative due to tightened discount rates affecting future equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite the FEDFUNDS increase, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in a two-tailed test).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in PAYEMS and UNRATE above their 12-month moving averages predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 days as labor market tightness weakens and investor sentiment deteriorates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive or the interaction p-value exceeds 0.05 in a regression controlling for inflation and GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST above 1.5% for three consecutive months is accompanied by a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days as it signals accelerating business demand and liquidity inflows.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases monthly for 3 months in a row
failure_condition: No significant return in the 5-day window (p > 0.1) or the effect reverses in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls below 100 (index) for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 forward 20-day return turns negative as it reflects reduced manufacturing capacity and tighter supply constraints.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or the effect is not statistically robust (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime where FEDFUNDS remains below 1% for 10 consecutive months, the S&P 500 exhibits positive 20-day forward returns as low rates encourage risk-on positioning.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is not significantly higher than the 30-day rolling average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 4% followed by a rise in PAYEMS above 145,000 suggests a transition from labor market stress to recovery, predicting a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and then PAYEMS > 145000 in the following month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are flat or negative, or the interaction is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in both GDPC1 and RSAFS above their 6-month moving averages for two months predict a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days as strong demand signals robust economic growth.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > GDPC1_6mo and RSAFS > RSAFS_6mo for 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or proxies move in opposite directions.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE remains above 5% for three consecutive months in a row, the S&P 500 forward 60-day return turns negative due to persistent labor market tightness depressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive or the effect is not robust across multiple backtests.
